flows.name: Service discovery to appointment request
flows.steps: Home > service finder preventative > cleaning service > team filter > select doctor > example branch > time preference > review > request only receipt; admin sees new demo request.
flows.oracle: All prefills correct and request clearly nonconfirmed.

flows.name: Parent explores first visit
flows.steps: Patient guide > first visit checklist > FAQs > linked service > request branch selection.
flows.oracle: Content actually informative; checklist local no PII.

flows.name: Invalid sensitive data path
flows.steps: User enters symptoms or medical record-like notes > copy discourages health details; server rejects restricted fields > safe error.
flows.oracle: No medical notes saved or logged; no fake clinician credential.

design: Calm specialist editorial. Sage #EDF5F2 / teal #193A39 / muted clay #A67A6D. Intentional personal portrait crops, accessible readability, reassuring patient guide layouts; no fake before/after patient images or fabricated treatment outcomes.
signatureFeatures: Service finder via concern categories (non-diagnostic) and plain language
Filter clinicians by service focus and available example consultation windows
Appointment request form with preferred day/time and honest non-confirmation
First-visit practical preparation guide with dynamic checklist
Long-form clinical content subject to expert review before production
seedRequirements: 10 services, 6 fictitious practitioner profiles without real credentials, 3 example clinic locations clearly fictional, 8 patient guides, 10 FAQs, 12 sample appointment preferences (non-confirmed).
adminRequirements: Services and clinics editorial content, practitioners (fictional), locations and availability examples, guides, FAQ and appointment request queue (requested/reviewed/archived). Public admin read-only tour available; full edits require auth.
negativeScenarios: Prefilled service and clinician match only appropriate services
Future slot preference must be future; no booking guarantee
Invalid email rejected but demo guest mode possible
No fields for diagnosis, images, patient history or DOB
All medical articles flagged as example subject to clinician review
